lines.zh: 我的袍子破了，露出别的颜色。
lines.en: My robe is torn, showing other colors underneath.

lines.zh: 我走路一高一低，腿不太对。
lines.en: I walk unevenly. My legs aren't right.

lines.zh: 我用手杖点地，点出湿印。
lines.en: I tap the ground with my staff and leave wet marks.

lines.zh: 我身上长出了一些不是我的手。
lines.en: Some of the hands on me aren't mine.
I head for the village. There are people there.
My knee bends the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我身后拖着一小段东西。
lines.en: Something trails behind me.
I cross the grass and it blackens.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，手指多了一根。
lines.en: I raise a hand and there's one finger too many.
The grass blackens where I step.

lines.zh: 这具身体已经不完全是我的。
lines.en: This body isn't entirely mine anymore.
And it still obeys me.

lines.zh: 我站着，肩上有东西在动。
lines.en: I stand, and something on my shoulder moves.

lines.zh: 我念咒，念出来的不是原来的词。
lines.en: I chant, and the words aren't the old ones.

lines.zh: 我的手杖上缠着一层东西。
lines.en: Something is wrapped around my staff.
I'm listening to the sounds inside me.
There are two heartbeats, at different speeds.
I raise a hand and watch it change.

lines.zh: 关节响了一下，位置变了。
lines.en: A joint cracks and settles elsewhere.
I breathe slowly. It's a strain.

lines.zh: 地上爬过一只虫子，绕开了我。
lines.en: A bug crawls past and avoids me.

lines.zh: 地上那些虫子都绕开了。
lines.en: The bugs on the ground all go round me.
Do you still know this robe?
I used to wear this too.
Now it's growing into me.
You back off, and I half exhale.
Stand back; my spells miss.
My spells aren't accurate now.
Sometimes they hurt me instead.
Sometimes they hurt you.
I can't much control it.
So you'd better stand back.
A lump of flesh drops off my shoulder.
It crawled back on its own.
I feel pain, and it isn't mine.
My robe is wet.

lines.zh: 那从袍子上滴下来的不是水。
lines.en: What drips from my robe isn't water.
I step back twice and lean on the wall.
The wall softens behind me.
I move away quickly.
I speak a line, and get it wrong.
This body gets harder to use.
What's in your hand, I don't want it.
The thing in my body does.
Put it down and it'll come.
I can't hold it back.
It likes living things.
You don't count as living yet, do you?

lines.zh: 那只手先替我迈了一步。
lines.en: That hand takes a step for me.
I'm pulling it back.
I can't quite hold it back.
You'd better run.
You hit me. I'm soft.
A piece came off.
It moved on the ground.
I've got it pinned underfoot.
My arm touched you. It's cold.
That spot will itch.
Don't scratch that spot.
Scratching spreads it.
I back off and stand a few paces away.
That's better for you.
I can't remember that clearly.
I remember having a home.
I remember the door was green.
Then I got sick.
Not that kind of sickness.
It grew from inside.
The others left first.
I stayed.
Now I'm not really staying either.
Ask something else, if you like.
I bend, and my back makes a sound.
I pick it up and look at it.

lines.zh: 它抢在我前面抓了东西。
lines.en: It grabs something before I can.
It took it from me.
I snatch it back again.
We each have half.

lines.zh: 我的手指长得比原来多。
lines.en: I've grown more fingers than I had.
It brings it back to me.
We go on like this a long while.
In the end I let go.
I see the village.
There's smoke from a chimney.
I raise the staff.
I speak a line.
A ring of teeth rises from the ground.
Not the kind I intended.
They're heading for the houses.
Someone's come out.

lines.zh: 我的手杖举到一半，停住。
lines.en: My staff stops halfway up.
That one, I hesitated.
The thing inside me didn't.
It finished the spell for me.
I listen to every word of it.
That sound. I know it.
I've spoken it many times.

lines.zh: 那只多出来的手，指着你。
lines.en: The extra hand is pointing at you.
I push it down.
It comes up again.
We try again.
That hand reaches forward again.
I've stepped back myself.
We pull against each other.
A tendon twitches behind my knee.
Half of that is me.

lines.zh: 你的位置，它已经记住了。
lines.en: It's memorized your position.
So have I.
I won't tell it.
It already knows.
It's cleverer than I thought.
It's waiting for you to move.
Don't let this hand of mine reach you.
It can't predict. I hold it down.
I pin it under my knee.
I raise a hand and spikes burst out.
They miss and hit the wall.
I rein in the second.
That hand let it out for me.
It hit you.
I chant to force it back.
That extra hand is pulling at me.

lines.zh: 骨头在身体里错位，卡住。
lines.en: My bones have shifted out of place and stuck.
I can't hold and go to my knees.
It's still pushing forward.
I grip the staff.
I snap the staff.
It quiets a little.
It has only quieted a little.
I lift my face slowly.
I'm sorry. I can't hold it.

lines.zh: 我从一间屋子里走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of a house.
The family crest is still on the door.
That's my family crest.
I used to belong to this house.

lines.zh: 现在我走出去，房子在后面。
lines.en: Now I walk out and the house is behind me.
The door shuts behind me.

lines.zh: 路上有别人留下的痕迹。
lines.en: There are traces others left on the road.
I know these traces.
It's the same sickness.
I raise the staff.
The staff is already cracked.
It'll serve a while longer.

lines.zh: 火一烧，它在我皮肤下面动得更凶。
lines.en: The fire makes it thrash harder under my skin.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，骨头断了两根。
lines.en: I hit the ground and two bones break.

lines.zh: 水进到肺里，它却在水里呼吸。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs, and it breathes in the water.

lines.zh: 炸响把我撕开，又合回来了。
lines.en: The blast tears me open and it closes back up.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我，被推了出来。
lines.en: An arrow goes in and gets pushed back out.

lines.zh: 这道咒想净化我，只烧掉了一半。
lines.en: That spell tried to cleanse me and only burned half.
An assimilated gut never fills.

lines.zh: 雷打在身上，我看见了两个自己。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I see two of myself.
We're both falling.
